text: Buying leads, but not booking jobs?
Sixty leads a month. Only two booked jobs.
Buying more leads won't fix it. It just raises your cost per job.
The problem is the leaks: slow replies, no qualifying, and no follow-up.
So the system answers every new lead in minutes, by text and call.
It scores each lead, and sends the hot ones straight to your calendar.
The rest get automatic follow-up, so no lead goes cold.
And we track booked jobs, not leads. Same sixty leads, now nine jobs a month.
It's a productized system. Set up once, measured every month.
Want more booked jobs from the same leads? Let's talk.
